sensitivity.title: Screening sensitivity
sensitivity.description: How closely a customer name must match a sanctioned name to flag.

watchlists.title: Watchlists
watchlists.description: Which sanctions lists to screen against. Disabling a list removes its matches on the next re-screen.
watchlists.ageUnknown: Age unknown — this list cannot say when it was last refreshed

cache.title: Cached lists
cache.description: Verified watchlists are cached on this device for fast cold starts and offline use. Clearing the cache frees space; the next load re-fetches and re-verifies every list.
cache.cleared: Cached lists cleared — the next load re-fetches and re-verifies.

banner.applied: Settings applied — no customers needed re-screening.
banner.unchanged: Settings unchanged — no changes to apply.
